responsibility: Renders solved dataflow analyses as Graphviz CFG diagrams with per-location state annotations. It formats basic blocks as HTML tables, reconstructs before/after state differences through the visitor interface, and labels edges and nodes according to MIR control flow and the selected output style.
same_name_distinction: This `graphviz.rs` renders solved dataflow analyses on MIR CFGs with per-location before/after state annotations. Unlike the borrow-check `graphviz.rs`, it is not about region constraints, and unlike `util/graphviz.rs`, it does not render generic MIR structure independent of a dataflow solution.
